title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF Brazil advanced efforts to address child poverty in Brazil by advancing evidence generation, influencing policy frameworks, and driving impactful advocacy. Key progress included advancing the embedding of multidimensional poverty measures into federal monitoring processes, publishing impactful studies, and ensuring that child poverty was prioritized in the agenda of the G20 Brazil. Strategic partnerships with government agencies strengthened national and local systems, while a pilot initiative in Amazonas demonstrated scalable solutions for reducing deprivations. These efforts solidified UNICEF’s role as a key technical partner and advocate, laying a strong foundation for sustainable progress in 2025.
Routine measurement and reporting on child poverty is nationally owned
